title: Orders From No King
description: The Forgotten Banner: Orders From No King unfolds across wind-torn bridge causeway with shredded banners, rusted standard sockets, and buckled oath plates, pushing the one active deity Asgardian deity to convert endurance into decisive counterpressure. Appearance rule: Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds is the source culture humans later copied as Norse saga myth; mission terrain and cosmetics must show rune iron, stormsteel, oath rings, raven omens, wolf teeth, Yggdrasil roots, frost-bitten leather, blackwinter scars.
lore: This mission treats Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds as the origin behind Norse saga myth: battlefield architecture, reward cosmetics, relic props, and hazard silhouettes must use rune iron, stormsteel, oath rings, raven omens, wolf teeth, Yggdrasil roots, frost-bitten leather, blackwinter scars instead of generic historical or RPG dressing.
terrain: wind-torn bridge causeway with shredded banners, rusted standard sockets, and buckled oath plates; source-culture appearance layer: rune-storm bridges, oath-stone courts, Bifrost storm fractures, Yggdrasil root ramps, Valhalla shieldwall ruins; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: rune-iron oath axes, stormsteel wolf-cloak mail, Yggdrasil thunder-root cores, Valkyrie witness counters

objectives.primary: Complete Orders From No King with one active deity while reading wind-torn bridge causeway with shredded banners, rusted standard sockets, and buckled oath plates and preserving faction doctrine.
optional: Keep at least four Titan standing
Trigger at least two Oathbound counterattacks
Trigger at least one Momentum or Divinity decision before victory

specialRules: Storm Oath: Momentum surges after decisive movement through exposed lightning lanes.
Banner Pressure: enemy banners grant defense until physically broken by objective actions.
Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
Solo Deityic Scale: one active deity occupies the tactical focus; enemies, elites, and bosses scale around that single presence.
victoryConditions: Complete Orders From No King with one active deity while reading wind-torn bridge causeway with shredded banners, rusted standard sockets, and buckled oath plates and preserving faction doctrine.

stars.one: Primary completed under severe casualty or turn pressure
